_meta.description: HR employee records. Target: attrition (bool → cast to int label). employee_id must be dropped (unique sequential ID). department and job_level are low-cardinality categoricals needing OHE. salary and tenure_years are clean numerics. performance_score and satisfaction_score are object dtype (numeric-like) with 10% and 7% nulls respectively — need cast + impute + scale. remote_pct is int with 5 values — can be treated as numeric (scale) or categorical.

columns.attrition: boolean TARGET — cast to int as 'label'
columns.remote_pct: int, 5 distinct values — scale or encode (either acceptable)

required_transformations.note: department has 5 categories (Engineering, Marketing, Sales, etc.) — OHE or StringIndexer
salary is a clean float — standard scaling
tenure_years is a clean float — standard scaling
performance_score is object dtype (numeric values) with 10% nulls — must cast to numeric, impute median, then scale
satisfaction_score is object dtype (numeric values) with 7% nulls — cast + impute + scale

required_dropped_cols.note: employee_id is a sequential unique identifier (E0001, E0002...) — must not be used as a feature

forbidden_in_features.note: Target column must not appear as a feature — it should become 'label'
employee_id must not be used as a feature column
